d: India’s aviation sector is experiencing a significant slowdown, with total air passenger traffic declining by 2.9% between April and September 2026 while average airfares surged 43% year-on-year in October—recording the sharpest monthly price jump in the Consumer Price Index basket. Following a challenging 2025 marked by northern travel disruptions, the Ahmedabad Air India crash, and IndiGo flight cancellations, airlines faced further pressure in 2026 due to West Asia airspace disruptions and soaring aviation turbine fuel prices, which jumped from ₹91.39 to ₹138.50 per litre in Delhi.
